title: A Circuit Domain Generalization Framework for Efficient Logic Synthesis in Chip Design

layout.note: A central top-down flowchart (terminal, process boxes, two blue decision diamonds inside a thin blue loop frame) with two coloured bracket-shaped insets at the left and right of the Extract Node Id Set N step, each tied to it by a pair of dashed leader lines of its own colour. The loop returns through arrows on the right; the Y exit runs around the left edge down to the output.

lesson: To contrast a baseline with a proposed variant of one step in a standard algorithm, draw the whole flowchart once and expand only the changed step sideways into two colour-coded brackets (green default, orange ours) joined by dashed leaders, so everything else stays shared.
